notice.question: Which feature would you look for to spot a starfish relative?

discover.title: An ancient relative of starfish.

notice.question: Why might a slab contain so many “headless” trilobite bodies?

discover.title: They weren’t headless bodies after all.
discover.text: Trilobites grew by molting—crawling out of an old outer skeleton.
discover.source: CMC Stop 4 · Catalogs IP52930 and IP87975

notice.question: How do you think this hole formed?

discover.title: The mystery is real.
